build_task_frontend: build a frontend webapp using npm install and webpack dev for a given task directory
build_task_npm_install: build a task frontend by running npm install with force flag in the webapp subdirectory
build_task_webpack: build a task frontend by running npm run dev to compile webpack assets
review_build_task: review the build_task function that handles npm install and webpack build for frontend webapps
refactor_build_task: refactor the build_task function to use subprocess run instead of subprocess call for better error handling
